item.title: [−1] Foreign investors pulled ₹52,100 crore from Indian equities in October; 2026 outflows reach ₹3.12 lakh crore
item.description:
Up from ₹48,056 crore reported mid-month despite late-month buying. Crude near $114, US yields and the pull of AI stocks elsewhere drove selling. Foreign funds also sold debt. Ongoing.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — AI rotation abroad

Why it matters: Persistent foreign selling weighs on large caps and the rupee, leaving domestic funds to absorb supply.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −2, Rupee −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
